errors.text: The hypothesis treats increased high-frequency phonon-DOS intensity as evidence of reduced scattering or longer phonon lifetime. A harmonic DOS does not directly encode scattering rates or lifetimes; linewidth-resolved spectra, spectral energy density, or mode-resolved lifetime calculations are required.

It replaces the target Monte Carlo plus non-equilibrium molecular-dynamics protocol under a single-phase bcc constraint with speculative thermal annealing at 800–1200 K, without evidence that these conditions preserve the required bcc state or generate the proposed HfTi/TiZr network.

The proposed transition to ballistic or semi-ballistic transport through ordered channels is unsupported and substantially stronger than the target mechanism of reduced scattering plus percolative enhancement.
